# Stand Firm in the Storm
## Scripture
"Be watchful, stand firm in the faith, act like men, be strong." – 1 Corinthians 16:13
## Reflection
Paul's charge to the Corinthian church is a battle cry for every man who claims the name of Christ. Notice the progression: watchfulness comes first. A soldier who drifts through his day without awareness is a soldier who gets ambushed. Then comes standing firm—not wandering, not wavering, but planting your feet on the truth of the gospel when culture pushes back. "Act like men" is a call to maturity, to shoulder responsibility rather than shrink from it. And finally, "be strong"—but not in your own power. The strength Paul commands flows from a life rooted in faith, sharpened by discipline, and surrendered to God. Every rep in the gym, every early morning in prayer, every choice to resist temptation is training for the battles that matter. You were not made for comfort; you were made for courage. Today, don't coast. Watch. Stand. Lead. Strengthen yourself in the Lord, and let your life reflect the conviction of a man who knows whom he serves.
## Daily Challenge
Do 30 pushups, pausing at the top of each rep to thank God for the strength He supplies—then stand firm in one area where you've been tempted to waver today.
